title: SSP-6.1 — Uncataloged Files Report Evidence
summary: record the accepted local Uncataloged Files producer, table-only report, exact Finder targets and bounded verification
content_html:
SSP-6.1 — Uncataloged Files Report Evidence

Outcome

SSP-6.1 is complete. The ordinary local Uncataloged Files parent document now runs one focused producer on mount and Run/Refresh. It lists only Folder and File name for direct ordinary non-hidden files in exact existing canonical Work source directories that are not canonical Work primary sources. File name activates the existing local-target service, which revalidates the encoded projects/... target and reveals the file in Finder without opening it.

SSP-6 is parked before SSP-6.2. Missing Source Files remains unimplemented, and the current Studio Project State route, APIs, activity entry, generator, static Markdown, tests, and image-extension owner remain unchanged for SSP-6.3.

Delivered Contract

  • docs_uncataloged_files_report_v1 derives distinct directories from complete canonical project_folder plus optional project_subfolder, scans no other directory and does not recurse, and excludes hidden entries, directories, and known Work-detail trees.
  • Existing canonical Work source files are removed by resolved filesystem identity, so filesystem-equivalent Unicode spellings refer to the same file while every displayed filename retains its discovered spelling.
  • The response's report object contains only schema_version and ordered rows; each row contains only folder, file_name, and the encoded local_target. The browser shows only the two specified columns, one Run/Refresh control, and ordinary busy, empty, or current-error state. It creates no count, summary, timestamp, generated Markdown, retained presentation, search, sort, copy, or mutation control.
  • The local report registry, explicit loader, management service, POST /docs/uncataloged-files, and existing POST /docs/open-local-target are the complete runtime path. The public report registry does not expose this report, and no absolute filesystem path enters its response or browser state.
  • The external local dotlineform source document d-20260807-163356-b376d7 is the parent report host. Its generated by-ID document, tree, recent list, and search entry identify viewer_report: uncataloged_files with viewer_report_access: local.

Verification

  • The focused producer, report-contract, route, local-target, Project State producer, and Project State report-contract suite passed all 49 tests against an isolated writable external workspace. Fixtures cover incomplete declarations, distinct directories, optional subfolders, all ordinary extensions and no extension, hidden and Work-detail exclusions, duplicate references, deterministic ordering, Unicode-equivalent hard-link identity, parent traversal, and directory/file symlink containment.
  • The browser smoke passed table-only DOM and exact column assertions, the sole Run/Refresh button, exact encoded Finder target handoff, current-run failure clearing, strict rejection of extra report metadata, and the two exact service requests.
  • A live local management-service run returned a report object with exactly schema_version and rows, no absolute targets, no false uncataloged row for Work 00894's filesystem-equivalent doll moiré reduced.jpg, and no false uncataloged row for current canonical wa/ink primary sources. The remaining wa/ink rows are actual direct ordinary files without canonical primary-source references.
  • Focused Python compilation, changed JavaScript syntax checks, Studio and external dotlineform Docs builds, both search builds, generated report-host inspection, and git diff --check passed with zero Docs warnings.

Independent Review

The bounded diff adds the one explicit producer, browser module, route, service dispatch, local registry record, loader, client methods, focused tests, smoke, check registration, external parent document, and this delivery evidence. It does not change canonical Catalogue JSON, docs_project_state_report_v2, Project State presentation or host data, the old Studio workflow, public report assets, file state, or Catalogue media policy.

The implementation is slightly above the sanity note's rough line estimate because containment, strict response validation, self-contained filesystem fixtures, and the browser harness are explicit rather than delegated to a new shared framework. Review found the same predicted owners and no generic audit engine, mode-driven response, recursive discovery, persisted inventory, result metadata, browser absolute path, Unicode rewriting, inferred Work identity, mutation hook, or early retirement. This variance does not expand the accepted behavior or SSP-6.1 boundary.

Review Gate

SSP-6.1 is accepted and parked. Begin SSP-6.2 only after explicit implementation approval; it must remain a separate Work-grained producer, response, module, and parent report host and must not consume the Uncataloged Files response or candidate scan.
